name: Must Learn CodeQL Reference
description: Offline, AI-ready reference of CodeQL CLI commands, QL language constructs, and key standard-library classes.

entries.title: CodeQL CLI Commands
entries.summary: Overview of core CodeQL CLI commands.

entries.summary: Create a CodeQL database from source. Options, build modes, examples.

entries.summary: Run queries against a database and produce SARIF or other results.

entries.summary: Run a single query and print results.

entries.summary: List available language extractors.

entries.title: resolve packs

entries.title: database info
entries.summary: Display metadata about a CodeQL database.

entries.title: database cleanup
entries.summary: Compact a CodeQL database on disk.

entries.title: query compile
entries.summary: Compile or check QL source code.

entries.title: query format
entries.summary: Auto-format QL source code.

entries.title: pack publish
entries.summary: Publish a QL pack to a package registry.

entries.title: database bundle
entries.summary: Create a relocatable archive of a CodeQL database.

entries.title: database export-diagnostics
entries.summary: Export diagnostic information from a database.

entries.title: pack init
entries.summary: Initialize a new CodeQL pack.

entries.title: database run-queries
entries.summary: Run queries and store raw results in the database.

entries.title: database interpret-results
entries.summary: Interpret previously computed results into SARIF or CSV.

entries.title: bqrs decode
entries.summary: Convert BQRS result data into other formats.

entries.title: version
entries.summary: Print the CodeQL CLI version.

entries.title: pack upgrade
entries.summary: Upgrade a pack’s dependencies to the latest versions.
